newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks drop 2.21 pct on finance sales.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks drop 2.21 pct on finance sales.

text.p: Concerns that more finance companies might be suspended led investors to sell stocks, especially of finance companies, on Wednesday and drove the market down 2.21 percent in late morning, brokers said.
The SET index declined to 634.12, down 14.35 points or 2.21 percent by 0419 GMT.
"Investor worries that more finance companies might be suspended came after the government yesterday ordered operations of 42 finance firms suspended," said Thanawat Patchimkul.

The finance company suspension was part of a series of strict monetary and fiscal measures aimed at healing the country's ailing economy. It brought to a total of 58 finance companies suspended by the government since June.
By 0438 GMT the index slipped further to 627.19, down 21.28 points or 3.28 percent, on 997 million baht turnover.
